capabilities: Display an animated pixel-art pet in the workspace
Drag the pet anywhere in the workspace
Toggle the pet via command palette
Configure animation frames, scale, and movement
extras: Includes bundled artwork by Elthen and the author; notes that custom sprites must be transparent .png spritesheets and may need manual horizontal reflection.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to add a lightweight animated desktop pet to the workspace.
summary: Desktop pet that adds an animated pixel-art cat (or custom sprites) roaming inside your Obsidian panes.
